Military Services Propose Changes to Agniveer Scheme

India's Army, Navy, and Air Force have reportedly sent a proposal to the government suggesting modifications to the Agniveer recruitment scheme. The proposed changes appear to aim at retaining a larger number of Agniveers beyond the initial four-year term. This comes as the military seeks to address potential needs and improve the scheme's long-term viability.
